name: Legacy of Ozem
body:
Source Champions of Purity pg. 23
Your purity is so great that the blades and bows of long-forgotten heroes sing to you as if they had been made for your righteous hands.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +5, good alignment.

Benefit: When using good-aligned weapons, including those under the effects of a bless weapon spell, you gain a +1 sacred bonus on damage rolls.
